login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Sign in to find your donations, receipts and event registrations.
login.noAccount: Don’t have an account yet? <link>Create an account</link>
login.expiredText: For your security, you have been signed out. Please sign in again to continue.
login.codeDescription: To protect team accounts, a 6-digit sign-in code has just been sent to {email}.
login.codeHint: Valid for 10 minutes. Remember to check your spam folder.
login.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits you received by email.
login.trustDeviceHint: You will not be asked for a code on this device. Only tick this on a personal device.
login.codeResent: A new code has just been sent. Only the latest code is valid.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Create a guest account: sign up as a volunteer for our volunteering events, track your donations and download your receipts.
register.teamNote: Would you like to become a member of HOPE International Project or join the team (employee, regional coordinator)? A guest account is not enough: <link>submit your application</link> and we will get back to you.
register.sentDescription: Your sign-up request has been processed.
register.sentText: If the address {email} is not already in use, your guest account has been created: you can sign in right away. A welcome email has been sent to you.
register.sentHelp: Already had an account with this address? Sign in with your usual password or use “Forgot password”. No email after a few minutes? Check your spam folder.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.description: Enter the email address of your account and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this email, a reset link has just been sent.
forgot.sentHelp: The link is valid for 1 hour. Remember to check your spam folder. Nothing received? <button>Make a new request</button>

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: To keep your account secure, choose a password you don’t use anywhere else.
reset.invalidText: This reset link is incomplete, has already been used or has expired (it is valid for 1 hour).
reset.doneText: Your new password has been saved. You can now sign in with it.

changePassword.title: Change my password
changePassword.description: Your new password will replace the current one on all your devices.
changePassword.requiredDescription: To secure your account, choose your own personal password. The temporary password you received by email will then stop working.
changePassword.mandatory: This step is required before you can access your account.

security.title: Change my password
security.tip1: Choose a unique password, ideally at least 12 characters long.
security.tip2: After a change, your other sessions are signed out automatically.
security.tip3: HOPE International Project will never ask for your password by email or phone.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.text: Lost phone, shared computer? Sign out everywhere your account is open, including here. You will need to sign in again on each device.
sessions.confirmText: All your sessions will be closed, including on this device.

profile.title: My details
profile.phoneHint: Useful for Mobile Money donations and events.
profile.managedNote: To change your email, region or roles, write to us from the Contact page: this information is managed by our team.

events.emptyText: Workshops, fundraising days, meet-ups: join us in the field at our upcoming events.
events.noUpcoming: No upcoming events. <link>Browse the events calendar</link> to sign up.
events.leaveText: Your place at “{title}” will be released for someone else.

hero.title: Give children the means to <hl>grow</hl>
hero.lead: Every donation funds school supplies, sponsorships, healthcare and practical support for the most vulnerable in Cameroon. You choose where your generosity goes; we show you what it makes possible.

noProvider.title: Online payment is coming very soon
noProvider.text: Our secure payment methods are being activated. In the meantime, you can give by bank transfer or Mobile Money by writing to us at {email} or through the Contact page: we reply within 48 hours.

support.description: A monthly donation lets us plan sponsorships and support over time.

impact.sentence: {amount}{frequency, select, monthly { a month} other {}}{currency, select, xaf { (≈ {equivalent})} other {}} could provide, for example, {impact}
impact.sponsorship: a year of school sponsorship for a child: school fees, supplies and follow-up throughout the year.
impact.business: a cheque of {grant} to help a mother start or grow her small business, as on International Women's Day.
impact.medical: medical help for a sick, elderly or disabled person: a consultation and medicines.
impact.christmas: a Christmas present and a festive meal for a child in an orphanage.
impact.schoolKit: a school kit for a child at the start of the school year: exercise books, pens, a ruler and a slate.
impact.hygieneKit: a hygiene kit for a vulnerable person: soap, a toothbrush and toothpaste.
impact.fund: a contribution to our work in the field: back-to-school drives, health campaigns and support for the most vulnerable.

success.title: Thank you!
success.lead: Your donation of {amount}{frequency, select, monthly { per month} other {}} will directly help children and vulnerable people regain hope. The whole HOPE International Project team warmly thanks you.

next.projectsText: Education, health, social support: follow the actions you make possible.

pending.title: Your payment is being processed
pending.lead: Depending on the payment method, especially Mobile Money, confirmation may take a few minutes. As soon as we receive it, your receipt will be emailed to you.
pending.pollingNote: Automatic check in progress: this page updates as soon as your operator confirms the payment.
pending.pollingPaused: Confirmation has not arrived yet. Approve the request on your phone, then check again.

review.title: Your payment is being reviewed by our team
review.lead: We are checking this payment before confirming it. Your receipt will be emailed to you as soon as it is approved: there is nothing you need to do in the meantime.

disputed.title: This donation is subject to a dispute
disputed.lead: Your bank has notified us of a dispute on this payment: the receipt is suspended until the dispute is resolved. If you did not initiate this dispute, please contact us.

refunded.title: This donation has been refunded
refunded.lead: The amount of this donation has been returned to you and its receipt has been cancelled. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.

canceled.title: The payment did not go through
canceled.lead: The payment was cancelled before it was approved: no money has been taken.

failed.title: The payment did not go through
failed.lead: Your bank or operator declined the payment: no money has been taken. You can try again, possibly with another payment method.
